audit_findings.sharpe_discrepancy: Phase 8 reported 3-seed arithmetic mean (1.508 / 1.687 / 1.702); Phase 8.1/8.2 reported Seed 42 alone (1.191 / 1.340 / 1.403). Both are algebraically verified from source data.
audit_findings.return_discrepancy: Phase 8 had double transaction cost subtraction in simulate_portfolio_strategy; Phase 8.1/8.2 resolved to single subtraction on net return.
audit_findings.economic_benefit_discrepancy: +4.77% represents strictly matched-exposure M13; +5.27% represents raw unscaled M13. Matched (+4.77%) is the canonical protocol.
audit_findings.turnover_netting: Turnover netting is a genuine mathematical identity resulting from weekly asset rotations (overlap=0 => TO = s_t + s_{t-1} = 2*s_bar). Naive bounds double-count exposure shifts.
